top_signals.title: Copper Slumps Below $14,000 as Tech Selloff Rattles LME Metals
top_signals.summary: Copper slumped to an 11-week low — dropping below $14,000 a ton — as a fresh selloff in technology stocks hurt risk appetite and clouded the demand outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: JPM’s Michele Tells US Treasury ‘Get Rid of the 20-Year’
top_signals.summary: Bob Michele, global head of fixed income at JPMorgan Asset Management, offers guidance to the US Treasury ahead of the November 2026 quarterly refunding announcement. He says the equity market “is going to go through some of its demons” to the benefit of the bond market and provides his outlook for bond yields. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
top_signals.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.
